scope: Read-only review of the pinned eleven-file source snapshot plus existing downstream consumer source, live GitHub metadata, and guarded test journals. No external dispatch, build, source edit, commit, or test run by this peer.
verdict_A_reason: The source connects the pushed release receipt to a one-time exact-main CI dispatch, full non-doc checks, an exact-source development artifact, and both promotion and hosted-test consumers. A native hosted release using this change has not run, so no exact-source development artifact, import, or hosted acceptance is observed. In-flight dedup reports already-running, not artifact success.

findings.claim: Completed-success dedup can report artifact-exists for an artifact the importer rejects.
findings.evidence: Pinned scripts/release-development-ci.mjs:65-76 checks name, expiry, byte size, and artifact.workflow_run.head_sha, then :22-28 reports artifact-exists. Pinned scripts/current-test-artifact.mjs:297-323 also requires artifact.workflow_run.id == run.id and a sha256 digest; hosted-remote-admission.mjs:1758-1768 requires a sha256 digest. An API artifact lacking either field passes the dedup predicate yet cannot be imported or admitted. The focused test at scripts/release-development-ci.test.mjs:35-66 injects hasDevelopmentArtifact=true, bypassing the actual API predicate. Align dedup with consumer metadata before treating completed CI as coverage.
findings.limit: No malformed real GitHub artifact was observed. This is a predicate counterexample in the pinned source, not a claim that GitHub currently emits malformed artifacts.

prior_findings.claim: Human workflow_dispatch actor cannot supply the artifact
prior_findings.evidence: Pinned scripts/development-ci-event.mjs:2-4 accepts push or workflow_dispatch without an actor restriction; importer, hosted admission, and scope reuse this predicate. GitHub itself authorizes dispatch callers.

prior_findings.claim: An in-progress run is incorrectly reported as completed artifact coverage
prior_findings.evidence: Pinned scripts/release-development-ci.mjs:22-30 returns already-running separately from artifact-exists. It is pending work and remains live-unverified until CI completes.

prior_findings.claim: A completed successful CI run without any development artifact covers the release
prior_findings.evidence: Pinned scripts/release-development-ci.mjs:63-78 lists artifacts and requires hasDevelopmentArtifact before artifact-exists; otherwise :30 dispatches. The remaining metadata mismatch is reported above.

claim_evidence.claim: The receipt carries source identity needed by dispatcher
claim_evidence.evidence: Existing scripts/sync-unpacked-release.mjs:193-213 writes sourceSha, publishState, both ZIP hashes, and treeSha256. claim_evidence.claim: Dispatch binds the new CI run to the pushed exact source
claim_evidence.evidence: Pinned scripts/release-development-ci.mjs:54-99 requires pushed receipt, checks main, lists same-SHA CI, and posts ref main with expected_source_sha and requested_by. Pinned ci.yml:63-77 calls assert-source before classification; script :102-109 rejects changed ref or SHA. Scope classification forces full for workflow_dispatch (ci-change-scope.mjs:105-116); CI checks and resource-guard-integration require scope success, while build/produce/upload run on main dispatch. CI uses the existing resource and cost gates.

claim_evidence.claim: Artifact remains exact and rechecked through consumers
claim_evidence.evidence: Pinned current-test-artifact.mjs:130-177 binds producer to GITHUB_SHA, checked-out HEAD, and expected_source_sha, with event in provenance. Import at :297-356 validates run, artifact, digest, provenance, and tree. Cached import at :359-424 rechecks tree and source state. Existing promote-ci-dev-artifact.mjs:25-108 and verify-ci-dev-promotion.mjs:25-100 require exact source and checked tree; hosted-guest-acceptance.mjs:68-103 uses the same importer and verifier. Hosted remote admission accepts the shared event predicate at :1725-1780.

claim_evidence.claim: Cost and permission scope are accounted for
claim_evidence.evidence: Pinned release.yml adds actions:write alongside contents:write for the dispatch and no schedule or new runner. Pinned ci-cost.json estimates at most 13 extra full runs/week, about $1.51/week list price and $0 billed increment for this public repository. Historical actual CI spend $91.79/$100 is not authorization for a future paid action. The aidream-wide ~$150 forecast and sandbox checker drift are pre-existing separate validator issues; this report does not claim whole-validator green.
